title: hold.ack item (Edge -> cloud)
description: The single item of the response frame (op 'hold.ack') that acknowledges a hold.place or hold.release notify. The cloud re-sends an unacknowledged hold notify after every hello.ack until it is acknowledged.

activeHoldDigest.description: SHA-256 hex over the sorted, newline-joined active hold ids after applying this notify; the cloud compares it with its own set.
